function.arguments: {"observation": "The `customer_age` column contains 108 values of -1, which are sentinel values for missing data. Among loyal customers, 23 out of 170 have age = -1, meaning 13.5% of loyal customers are missing age data.", "implication": "The question asks for the mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers — a subgroup that includes people with missing age. Since age is not part of the target estimand (revenue), and the missingness is not related to order value (no evidence of systematic bias), we can proceed without adjusting for age. The missing age does not confound the revenue estimate for loyal customers, so it does not change the method."}
function.name: note_finding
